readEvidence.stem: Why must the source’s “CAN: 1 Mbps” entry be qualified when discussing the entire CAN family?

options.text: All CAN variants must use the same bit rate in every frame phase and the same maximum payload.
CAN FD increases payload size but by definition cannot change the data-phase bit rate.
The 1 Mbps entry fits the Classical CAN context; CAN FD permits a faster data phase under suitable conditions.
CAN FD’s faster data phase means bus topology and transceiver timing can always be ignored.
